prompt: Create a production top-down scrolling terrain tile for Bullets of Fury, a detailed 16-bit arcade vertical shoot-em-up. Stage 8 is an unknowable alien code/symbiote realm. Straight overhead orthographic, no horizon or perspective, no UI, no text or logo, no ships. Dark obsidian organic circuitry, sinewy biomechanical ridges and broken alien glyph channels with restrained violet/cyan bioluminescence, strange ribbed growth at edges and quieter readable central flight space. Not a city, not human computer motherboards. Crisp clustered pixel art, metallic and fleshy relief, clear 16-bit shading, no blur. Portrait 2:3 terrain plate. Seamlessly repeat vertically: top and bottom edge should join perfectly with continuous dark channels, keep all major features away from both seams, use small irregular repeating texture near seams, no landmark repeated giant planets. Low contrast terrain so projectiles stay readable. This is an in-game raster terrain asset, fill the entire image.

Production sprite animation atlas for Bullets of Fury's new alien code/symbiote enemy family. One precisely aligned 4 COLUMN x 4 ROW grid on transparent background, equal-size square cells, no labels or grid lines. Four columns for EACH row show SAME hull and same scale: neutral forward, slight bank left, slight bank right, forward firing pose with small focused angular energy flare at downward-facing weapons. Not abstract mandalas, no round orb ships, no giant circular shields, no ships facing up. Neatly centered consistently within all 16 cells for a game programmer to slice into animation frames.

Use the attached sheet ONLY as character identity/style reference. Generate a new production 4 columns x 4 rows animation atlas, 16 equal square cells, transparent background, no text or dividers. Preserve EXACT same dark steel robot, round energy chest core, cylindrical double-headed energy hammer, no cape and no back gun. Detailed crisp 16-bit arcade sprite art, full body each frame same scale, feet anchored consistently, south/front facing toward viewer. Row 4 four silver-white CHROMIUM BARRIER effects only, NO robot: energetic vertical planar shield wall, horizontal wide silhouette with sharp crackling rim, transparent interior and clearly readable energy veins, beginning/rising/full/pulsing phases. Keep all sprites comfortably INSIDE their equal-sized cells with 10 percent margins so none cross neighboring cells. No black or checkerboard background.

This is an in-game stage title sign, premium hand-pixelled arcade metalwork, not a poster. Only specified text, no footer, no watermark. Edit the supplied exact game terrain tile: REMOVE ALL WATER to true transparency. This is a precision background extraction for a layered 16-bit game. Keep ALL solid industrial platforms, walkways, buildings, pipework, support pylons, reactor structures and their cyan/amber lights exactly in the same positions, same scale and same pixel art design.
